investigations.summary: 3.8.0/3.8.1 × MySQL 8.0, 8.4 and 9.7 (6 lanes): PMM-T2663 failed again with 'pmm-admin: error: unknown flag --skip-connection-check'. The test was added in #1777, the flag first shipped in pmm-client 3.9.0, and the test has no version gate. Night 110 found the same failure; open pmm-qa#1791 gates the test at 3.9.0 and has not merged yet. Deduped, not re-reproduced.

3.10.0 · Percona Server 8.0: only PMM-T2528 failed (49 passed). The slowlog agent disable returned OK, but PMM Server kept mysqld_exporter 'Running' for 60 s instead of 'Done (disabled)'. That is the open PMM-15835 lost update (a ChangeAgent racing the agent's status report), the same failure nights 109 and 110 traced. Deduped, not re-reproduced.
